title: Should I take a gap year before university?
L: W
(1) Ben: I finish high school in June, and I can't decide what to do next.
W
Some of my friends are going straight to university, but I'm thinking about taking a gap year.
W
I'd like to work and travel, but my parents think I'll never go back to studying.
W
What would you do in my shoes?
W
(2) Chloe: I took a gap year, and it was the best decision I've ever made.
W
I worked in a café for six months, saved up some money, and then volunteered abroad.
W
When I started university, I felt more focused than most of my classmates.
W
(3) Dan: Honestly, I'd say it depends. A gap year only works if you have a plan.
W
My cousin took one without any goals and just played games all year.
W
So set clear goals first, and then talk to your parents about them.
